decision.article_title: Pramatra Space building chip-based quantum security for space & ground networks - YourStory.com
decision.reason: YourStory confirms Pramatra Space third QKD chip tape-out, PQC/QKD hybrid tests and planned 2027 demonstration; chip fabrication and quantum-key runtime cannot be reproduced as zero-external-service Lovable SaaS; any generic test evidence ledger lacks a distinct verified unmet workflow.
